text: Ohhh… I can't keep my eyes open. I could sleep standing up!
The room is spinning like a washing machine!
Look at my hands! They won't stop shaking!
My heart is racing, nurse. Boom-boom-boom!
I am so tired… but in bed, I just stare at the ceiling.
I am sweating, and my face is white. Is the air-con on?
Two cups. Maybe three. Okay… eight.
It hurts a lot. I cannot sleep.
It hurts a little. I can ignore it.
It hurts, but I can still walk.
It began on Wednesday.
I have felt tired since Monday.
Every night for two weeks, I cannot sleep.
She sleeps three hours a night. The recommended amount is seven to nine hours.
Her pulse is one hundred and fifty. Normal is sixty to one hundred.
Her pulse is thirty-eight beats a minute. Normal is sixty to one hundred.
My hands are shaky and my heart is racing. What is wrong with me?
Eight cups a day! Coffee is my best friend.
I feel nauseous and sweaty. What is wrong with me?
No fever. No cough. Only my cat looks worried.
I am exhausted and dizzy. What is wrong with me?
Yes! They started two weeks ago. And my cat watches me all night.
Okay, okay. You are right. But I need one more coffee.
My heart is fine. Totally normal.
I sleep about six hours.
Only two cups on Friday!
